const cartItems = [ { id: 1, name: 'VELOCE Apex Pro', price: 289, size: '10', tag: 'NEW' }, { id: 2, name: 'Shadow Runner X', price: 245, size: '9.5', tag: 'HOT' }, { id: 3, name: 'Neon Drift 07', price: 320, size: '11', tag: 'NEW' }, ]; function Cart() { const subtotal = cartItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0); const shipping = 0; const total = subtotal + shipping; return (

YOUR CART

{cartItems.length} items ready to checkout.

{cartItems.map((item) => (
👟

{item.name}

Size {item.size} · {item.tag}

${item.price}

))}

Order Summary

Subtotal ${subtotal}
Shipping {shipping === 0 ? 'Free' : `$${shipping}`}
Total ${total}

Free express shipping for VELOCE Elite members.

); } export default Cart;
